item.title: Fanobase: Fano Tuesday
item.description:
We've started Fano Tuesday, a weekly series on the Fanobase blog. Each week, we'll discuss something interesting about one or more Fano fourfolds appearing in our project.

The first instalment is about Küchle's list and how it inspired Fanobase. In some sense, growing his list of 17 families to as many as possible is precisely one of the goals of Fanobase.

item.title: Fanobase: the type A beta release
item.description:
As previously established, I like

  • making websites
  • classification results

Together with several collaborators, we've just released a beta version of Fanobase: a database of Fano 4-folds constructed as zero loci on products of type A partial flag varieties.

type-a.fanobase.net

For more on what we are doing, see the announcement blogpost. This is very much work in progress: we will be releasing more examples and data on a regular basis, with updates on the Fanobase blog.
